verdict.rationale: AI Gateway is an API-first service that requires no interactive UI. Its docs state that its API keys work in CI and on external servers, and requests authenticate with an API key or OIDC token. That makes headless, CI-driven automation a documented, first-party capability. missing for 10: a dedicated CI integration guide (e.g. GitHub Actions or pipeline examples), documented non-interactive behavior for the `vercel ai-gateway` CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: AI Gateway API keys belong to a Vercel team and work in local development, CI, external servers, and Vercel deployments.
Every request to AI Gateway requires Vercel authentication. Use an AI Gateway API key or OpenID Connect (OIDC) token.
Use one managed gateway from any infrastructure to centralize credentials, log requests, control spend, and fail over across providers.
Point your existing client to the AI Gateway's base URL
